comparison_policy.provenance: Observation informed the explicit successor. No particle name, mass, cross section, uncertainty, source locator or dimensional conversion is readable by the executable law. Enumeration and sealing precede target release.
comparison_policy.residual: Positive NIST neutron-hydrogen and neutron-deuterium scattering intervals support a nonempty interaction outside individually colour-neutral nucleon boundaries.
comparison_policy.strength_boundary: The large disjoint channel cross sections reject interpreting the exact structural quarter-One as a universal measured nuclear cross section or strength coefficient.
comparison_policy.range: The complete PDG mass intervals are translated through the NIST displayed hbar-c enclosure only after sealing. Pion reciprocal-mass ranges must lie above rho/omega ranges, and every value and uncertainty remains visible.
comparison_policy.cutoff_boundary: The reciprocal mass is a finite decay scale, not a claim that the interaction becomes numerical zero at a hard radius.
